response.result:
The all-time most-replied discussion on FlightAware is **The Banter Thread**, in the General category of FlightAware Discussions, and it is open here: https://discussions.flightaware.com/t/the-banter-thread/4412

To find it I went from the FlightAware home page to the Discussions community, then used the site's own Top list sorted by Replies over the all-time period. The Banter Thread heads that list with 5.5k replies and 2.4M views, last activity Jun 2018. The runner-up, "HOWTO: Airspy mini and Airspy R2: Piaware / dump1090-fa configuration", has 4.6k replies, and third is "ADS-B Receiver Project Setup Scripts" at 1.9k.

On the thread itself the timeline reads "1 / 5519", meaning 5,519 posts in total — 5,518 replies — started in Dec 2007 and last posted in Jun 2018.
